meta.name: Duello Quiz design tokens
meta.direction: v3 minimal ('dəftər' / notebook): warm paper and ink, one pomegranate ('nar') accent, saffron only for the streak, a serif display face with a sans UI face, flat hairline cards, pill buttons, a small fixed set of hand-made touches (squiggle underline, rotated sticker, dashed boxes, serif numerals). Approved by Sabit 2026-11-16 (mockup). Replaces the v2 vivid game style.
notes: Source of truth for colours, type, spacing, sizes, shapes, elevation and motion. Screen-by-screen impact of v3: design/screens/v3-migration.md.
color.<theme>.scheme keys are named exactly like the parameters of androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme (lightColorScheme / darkColorScheme). Map them 1:1; dynamic colour stays OFF.
color.<theme>.game keys are custom semantic roles that ColorScheme does not have. Expose them through a CompositionLocal (LocalGameColors) with the same names.

v2 -> v3 colour changes: violet primary -> nar red (#A82D25 light / #EC7B6F dark); pink tertiary (opponent) -> plum; sky-blue secondary -> blue ink (#2E5A78 / #9EC3DD, streak freeze, info, 'done' pills, queued answers); lavender surfaces -> warm paper #F5EFE3 / ink #17150F; burnt-orange streak -> saffron (game.streak for text/icons, game.streakFill for the week-dot fill). The mockup values (#B8322A, #E2675C) were deepened / lightened so the accent passes 4.5:1 as text on every surface container in both themes.

REMOVED in 3.0.0: color.<theme>.category (8 accent slots), color.categoryAccentOrder, color.categoryAccentDefaults, color.<theme>.gradient (duelHero, resultWin, dailyHero), all game.pressable* and game.*Depth roles, game.cardDepth, the depth block and motion.pressable. Every reference still found in a screen spec is mapped in 'deprecated' below; android-dev deletes the old Kotlin classes (CategoryColors, gradient brushes, PressableSurface depth) instead of keeping aliases.

REDEFINED in 3.0.0: game.cardBorder is now the 1dp hairline of flat cards (same value as scheme.outlineVariant, decorative). game.pendingContainer is a darker paper (the selected option is marked by a 2dp ink border + ink letter badge, not by the accent). game.timerNormal is ink, not the brand colour. game.confidence1..3 are increasing ink density (paper -> sand -> solid ink) with the 1-3 signal bars. game.confidenceSelectedOutline is the accent.

NEW in 3.0.0: game.streakFill / onStreakFill (filled week dot, check glyph), game.navIndicator (selected pill in the bottom navigation bar), game.inverseOnSurfaceVariant (muted text on the inverted duel card). The squiggle underline, sticker and selected Əminlik ring use scheme.primary; no extra role.
scheme.surfaceTint equals scheme.surface on purpose: v3 uses no tonal elevation, and a red tint on raised surfaces would look like an error state.

Error and accent are both reds. Error is never shown by colour alone: every error state has an icon and a sentence (components.md general rules). Correct/wrong options always carry a check / cross glyph and an outcome word.
All colours are opaque sRGB hex. Disabled states follow Material 3: content onSurface at 38 %, container onSurface at 12 % (see stateLayer).
Every text pair is checked in design/contrast-report.md (WCAG 2.1). Run design/tools/contrast.py after any colour change.
Units: dp for sizes, sp for font sizes and line heights, ms for durations, degrees for rotation.

3.1.0 (2026-11-21, mock exams 'Sınaqlar' Phase 1, design/screens/exam-*.md): no new colour roles. New size.exam*, size.scoreSplitBarHeight, shape.component.exam* / audioPlayer / markTile / segmentedToggle / scoreSplitBar, motion.exam. Font subsets gain U+2116 (numero sign, both families) and U+2153 / U+2154 (one third, two thirds; sans only — Fraunces has no such glyphs, so fractions are never set in the serif).

deprecated.notes: Keys removed in 3.0.0 and the token to use instead wherever an older screen spec still names them. Values are token NAMES, never hex. Do not recreate these keys in Kotlin.
deprecated.game.pressableNeutral / onPressableNeutr: transparent face, scheme.onSurface label, 1dp scheme.outline border (secondary pill button); as a card face: scheme.surface
deprecated.game.pressableDuel / onPressableDuel: scheme.primary / scheme.onPrimary (the duel has no own button colour in v3)
deprecated.game.*Depth, game.cardDepth, depth.*: none — v3 is flat; press feedback is motion.press
deprecated.gradient.duelHero: scheme.inverseSurface face, scheme.inverseOnSurface text (duel card v3, components.md §6)
deprecated.gradient.dailyHero / dailyHero.on / dail: scheme.surface card with game.cardBorder hairline, text scheme.onSurface (daily card v3, daily-tab.md)
deprecated.category.<slot>.face / onFace / depth: none — one colour for all categories: name scheme.onSurface, numeral scheme.primary, icon scheme.onSurfaceVariant
deprecated.category.<slot>.container / onContainer: scheme.surfaceContainerHigh / scheme.onSurfaceVariant (category icon squares on the profile and progress card)

stateLayer.notes: Disabled content = onSurface at 0.38, disabled container = onSurface at 0.12 (M3 standard). Disabled text is exempt from WCAG contrast; never use disabled styling for information the user must read. v3 press feedback = Material ripple in the content colour at pressedOpacity PLUS the small scale of motion.press on game inputs; no depth edge.

display.name: Fraunces
display.source: Google Fonts (github.com/google/fonts/ofl/fraunces, variable TTF with axes opsz 9-144, wght 100-900, SOFT 0-100, WONK 0-1), SIL Open Font License 1.1. Designers: Undercase Type (Phaedra Charles, Flavia Zimbardi).
display.use: display*, headline* and the custom roles numeral / numeralLarge only: greeting, 'Duel', screen headlines, big scores, '#12', the 01-05 list numerals. Never for body text, buttons, labels or the question.

instances.for: numeral, headlineSmall second greeting line (optional), italic-free accents

display.delivery: minSdk is 24 and font variation axes need API 26, so bundle STATIC instances in core/designsystem/src/main/res/font, generated from the variable TTF with `fonttools varLib.instancer` at the axis values above, then subset to Basic Latin + Latin-1 + Latin Extended-A/B + U+0259, U+2026, U+2212, U+2192, U+00B7, U+2013, U+2014, U+00AB, U+00BB, U+2116 (`pyftsubset`; U+2116 added in 3.1.0 for "Sınaq №1", verified present in the upstream variable TTF 2026-11-21). Expected size < 60 KB each. Do not use downloadable fonts: the first frame and offline start must already use the final font. WONK = 0 keeps the letters upright and readable; the 'human' feel comes from SOFT 50.
display.coverage: VERIFIED 2026-11-17 by reading the cmap of the variable TTF from github.com/google/fonts (ofl/fraunces, main): every Azerbaijani letter is mapped — Ə U+018F, ə U+0259, Ğ ğ, I ı, İ i, Ö ö, Ü ü, Ç ç, Ş ş — plus U+2212, U+00B7, U+2026. Cross-checked with the Google Fonts css2 `text=` kit: the kit for U+018F is a real glyph kit (956 bytes), while an unsupported character (Cyrillic Ж) returns a 1664-byte empty kit. Note: the css2 request alone is NOT proof — it returns a kit for any requested character.
display.features: Fraunces has NO tabular figures (no tnum in GSUB). Use it only for numbers that do not change while visible (#12, 01-05, a final score). Numbers that tick or count up (timer, score count-up, countdown, rating change) use the sans with tnum, or sit in a fixed-width box sized for the widest value.

brand.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
brand.status: DECIDED — replaces Manrope from the approved mockup (OQ-D34, Sabit 2026-11-17).
brand.source: Google Fonts (github.com/google/fonts/ofl/plusjakartasans, variable TTF wght 200-800), SIL Open Font License 1.1. Designers: Tokotype (Gumpita Rahayu).
brand.use: title*, body*, label*, overline: all UI text, buttons, the question and options, numbers that change.
brand.delivery: Static instances (google/fonts ships the variable file; instance with fonttools as for Fraunces, then subset the same ranges PLUS U+2153 and U+2154 (⅓ ⅔, self-assessment marks, added in 3.1.0; verified present in the upstream variable TTF 2026-11-21; the files shipped before 3.1.0 lack U+2116, U+2153, U+2154 — check with `python3 design/tools/text_width.py --glyphs "№⅓½⅔"`). Keep the tnum feature when subsetting (`--layout-features+=tnum`).
brand.coverage: VERIFIED 2026-11-17 by cmap of the variable TTF from github.com/google/fonts (ofl/plusjakartasans, main): all Azerbaijani letters including Ə U+018F and ə U+0259; U+2212, U+00B7, U+2026 present; GSUB has tnum and locl. css2 `text=` kit for U+018F is a real glyph kit (848 bytes).
brand.rejected: Manrope (approved in the mockup) FAILS: its cmap (google/fonts ofl/manrope, last updated 2026-09-14) has ə U+0259 but NOT the capital Ə U+018F, and the css2 kit for U+018F is the 1664-byte empty kit. Capital Ə starts very common words ('Əminlik', 'Əsas səhifə', 'Əla'), so Android would draw it from Roboto inside Manrope text. Also checked and failing: Figtree and Instrument Sans (no Ə/ə). Checked and passing (alternatives for OQ-D34): Onest, Hanken Grotesk, Work Sans, Public Sans, DM Sans, Inter, Schibsted Grotesk.
brand.features: Use tabular figures (fontFeatureSettings "tnum") for the timer, progress "3 / 10", score, rating, countdown and streak numbers.
brand.case: Sentence case everywhere. The only all-caps text is the overline role, and its strings are AUTHORED in capitals in copy/az.md ("TƏK OYNA · 10 SUAL"). Never uppercase at runtime (no textTransform, no String.uppercase): i/İ and ı/I casing depends on the locale.

fallback.name: serif / sans-serif (system: Noto Serif / Roboto)
fallback.notes: Only used if a bundled file fails to load; both system families cover Azerbaijani Latin.

overline.notes: Section labels ('TƏK OYNA · 10 SUAL', 'GÜNÜN ÇAĞIRIŞI'). Strings authored in capitals. scheme.onSurfaceVariant unless stated.

numeral.notes: Category list numbers 01-05 in scheme.primary. Static numbers only.

numeralLarge.notes: '#12' on the Gündəlik tab, the final daily score. Static numbers only.

notes: Names match androidx.compose.material3.Typography parameters; 'family' says which FontFamily (display = Fraunces, brand = Plus Jakarta Sans). custom.* are extra TextStyles in the design system (e.g. DuelloTypography.overline).
Sizes are sp so they follow the user's font scale. Every screen must work at font scale 1.3 without truncation and stay usable (scrolling allowed) at 2.0.
Question text uses titleLarge (sans 20sp Bold); options bodyLarge. Button labels labelLarge (15sp Bold). Dialog titles headlineSmall (serif) — the editorial accent of v3.

Width method (copy/az.md): advance widths read from the fonts' hmtx tables at the default instance — Plus Jakarta Sans wght 400 (+6 % for 700-800), Fraunces wght 900 / opsz 9 (its widest master, so serif estimates are conservative). Kerning ignored (over-estimates slightly).

layout.notes: screenGutter applies below 600dp width; screenGutterWide and centred maxContentWidth at 600dp and above. homeSectionGap = vertical gap between the home blocks (greeting, duel card, category section); tuned so home fits 360 x 740 (home.md).

size.categoryTileMinHeight: deprecated (3.0.0): no category tiles; see categoryRowMinHeight

notes.homeTopRowHeight: Date line + streak + avatar row on home (all touch targets 48dp).
notes.bottomBarHeight: Custom compact NavigationBar (icon 24 + label, stacked), not the 80dp M3 default — needed for the no-scroll home. System navigation bar inset is added below it.
notes.categoryRowMinHeight: Typographic category row; grows with font scale (name may wrap to 2 lines).
notes.stickerRotationDeg: Rotation of the rating sticker on the duel card (negative = counter-clockwise). The only rotated element in the app.
notes.squiggle*: Hand-drawn underline under one greeting word; drawn as a path (components.md §36) whose wave count grows with the word width.
notes.weekDot: Day dot in the 7-day streak row on the Gündəlik tab; the row cell is >= 40dp wide, the dot itself is not interactive.
notes.resultBox: Dashed / filled answer boxes on the Gündəlik tab (5 in a row). resultBoxCompact: same boxes inline in small places. resultSquare* kept for the daily result share card.
notes.progressBarHeight: v3 timer / progress bar is a thin 4dp line (v2: 12dp chunky).
notes.confidenceChip: Minimum height of an Əminlik tile (duel). Width is one third of the content width minus two space.md gaps (~101dp on a 360dp phone). A rounded rectangle, never a circle.
notes.levelBadge: Level number square on the profile (v3: 48dp, flat).
notes.streakBadgeMinWidth: Streak block (flame + number) in the home top row; also its minimum touch width (with minTouchTarget height).
notes.examTaskCell: Task cell in the exam task navigator (components.md §40): 48dp square = its touch target. examGridColumns = 6 cells per row on 360dp (6 x 48 + 5 x space.sm = 328dp); at >= 600dp the count is floor((width + 8) / 56).
notes.examFlagBadge: Flag badge circle at a task cell's top-end corner (12dp flag glyph inside).
notes.examAudioPlayButton: Round play / pause button of the listening player (components.md §42).
notes.examPlayDot: One dot per allowed listening play (2) next to the plays-left text.
notes.examWrittenFieldMinHeight: Written answer field (components.md §43): about 4 lines of bodyLarge; grows with the text, never scrolls inside itself.
notes.examPassageGutter: Start gutter of the reading passage that holds the paragraph numbers (components.md §41).
notes.examMarkTileMinHeight: Self-assessment mark tile (0, ⅓, ½, ⅔, 1; components.md §44). Width = (content width - 4 x space.sm) / 5, ~59dp on 360dp.
notes.examRowMinHeight: Two-line rows of the exam flow: Oyna 'Sınaqlar' row, catalogue variant row, history row.
notes.scoreSplitBarHeight: Score split bar on the exam result (components.md §45).

shape.notes: Names match androidx.compose.material3.Shapes (extraSmall..extraLarge) using RoundedCornerShape(dp). v3 radii are smaller and flatter (4/8/12/16/18); buttons, chips and the sticker are pills; cards 16dp, the duel card 18dp. shape.component.categoryTile and dailyCard 24dp of v2 are gone.

component.topAppBar: level0 — when content scrolls under it, a 1dp game.cardBorder hairline appears at its bottom
component.bottomBar: level0 — 1dp game.cardBorder hairline on its top edge
component.duelCard: level0 — solid ink block, no shadow

elevation.notes: v3 is flat: no depth edges, no blurred card shadows, no tonal elevation (surfaceTint = surface). Real shadows only on floating layers: dialog, snackbar, overlay card.

bouncy.use: v3: calmer than v2 (was 0.5 / 600). Pops: correct option, points, result hero, chip lock. Name kept because many specs reference it.

gentle.use: Press release (scale back to 1.0), sticker settle.

press.ripple: Material ripple in the content colour at stateLayer.pressedOpacity (ink on paper, paper on ink)
press.appliesTo: Scale + ripple: option card, Əminlik tile, category row, duel card. Ripple only, no scale: buttons, list rows, icon buttons, nav items. Not interactive at all: Gündəlik answer boxes, week dots, sticker.
press.haptic: HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove (light tick) on press-down for option card and Əminlik tile; none elsewhere.
press.reducedMotion: No scale; ripple stays (it is a state layer, not motion). The action always fires on click and never waits for the animation (DUEL-16).

game.quizRevealHoldSource: docs/mvp-spec.md §1 / OQ-023. Server deadline assumes 1500 ms; do not change without a spec change.
game.timerTick: linear, driven by wall-clock (not by animation frames)

timerWarningPulse.repeat: once per remaining second while <= 5 s

optionCorrectPop.notes: Correct card pops once; the check badge scales in 0 -> 1 with the same spring.

screenTransition.type: shared axis X (forward into a full-screen flow) / fade-through (switching bottom tabs, durationMs 200)

categoryListEnter.notes: Only on first load from network/cache, not on return from a quiz or a tab switch. Replaces categoryGridEnter.

squiggleDraw.notes: The greeting squiggle draws from start to end once per app start (path trim 0 -> 1). Not on tab switches or returns.

stickerSettle.notes: Sticker settles from 0 to its rotation once when the duel card first appears. Static afterwards.

duel.notes: Display-only timing for the duel UI. Phase lengths are server rules (docs/mvp-spec.md §2); the client always counts down to the server deadline and never ends or extends a phase on its own. Animations never delay sending a pick or an answer (DUEL-16).

phaseNominalMs.use: Denominator for the timer ring fraction only: fraction = clamp(remaining / nominal, 0, 1).

timerWarningThresholdMs.notes: 0 = no warning colour in that phase. Warning uses game.timerWarning and the existing timerWarningPulse.

phaseTransition.type: body content cross-fade + 1/8 height slide up; the pinned header never moves

confidencePanelEnter.type: panel slides up from the bottom edge + fade

chipPress.notes: motion.press on the Əminlik tile. round.bet is sent on the tap, before or in parallel with this animation.

revealFlip.rotation: rotationY 0 -> 180 deg, content swaps at 90 deg
revealFlip.notes: Both player panels flip in the SAME frame. Never staggered (fairness).

duel.revealMinRemainingNotes: If round.result arrives with less than this left in the result phase (late message, rejoin), skip flip and count-up and show the final state with a 150 ms cross-fade.

introEnter.type: self row slides in from the start edge, opponent row from the end edge, 1/4 width + fade, same start time

duel.reducedMotion: No pulse, slide, flip, pop, press scale or count-up: content cross-fades in 150 ms and numbers show their final value. Colours, timer ring and all game timing are unchanged.

progression.notes: Display-only motion for XP, levels, streak and the daily result. Never delays navigation or a request; values shown are always the server's.

xpGainPop.notes: '+70 XP' pops in after the score count-up has started.

xpBarFill.notes: Bar animates from the old to the new fraction. Total for one result <= 1 s (PROG-02).

levelUp.notes: On a level-up the bar fills to 100 %, the level number ticks to the new value, the bar restarts at 0 and fills to the new fraction; the level-up strip expands under it.

streakIgnite.notes: Outlined flame cross-fades to filled and pops once when the day becomes active (result screens, first home / Gündəlik frame of that Baku day).

resultSquaresEnter.notes: Daily result squares / Gündəlik answer boxes fill left to right after the score count-up.

weekDotFill.notes: Today's dot changes from dashed ring to filled once, the first time the Gündəlik tab shows todayActive = true on that Baku day.

progression.countdownTick: Countdown text updates once per second from the server-offset clock; no animation on the digits (tabular figures).
progression.reducedMotion: No pop, ignite, stagger, dot fill or bar animation: final values at once. Text and colours identical.

exam.notes: Mock exams (design/screens/exam-*.md). Calm on purpose: a 60-180 min attempt must not blink. The server deadline is the only clock; nothing here delays saving an answer.
exam.timerWarningNotes: Timer pill and time line switch to game.timerWarning at <= 10 min. No pulse at any time (unlike the quiz).
exam.timeNoticeNotes: Short snackbar + polite TalkBack announcement once per threshold; never repeated after a resume past the threshold.

taskTransition.type: horizontal pager settle (swipe) or fade-through (grid jump, Növbəti / Əvvəlki)

segmentSwitch.type: cross-fade Tapşırıq <-> Mətn; scroll positions kept

exam.navigatorSheetEnter: M3 modal bottom sheet default (expand to full height)
exam.audioProgress: linear, driven by the player position, updated every 250 ms

markSelect.notes: Selected mark tile fills with ink via a 150 ms colour cross-fade; press uses motion.press (ripple + 0.98).

scoreSplitFill.notes: Segments grow from 0 once when the result first shows; after a self-assessment update they animate from the old to the new width.

scoreChange.type: cross-fade of the serif score (Fraunces has no tabular figures: no count-up)

exam.reducedMotion: No pager slide (instant switch), no bar growth, no cross-fades longer than 150 ms; colours and the timer are unchanged.

motion.reducedMotion: When the system setting 'Remove animations' (ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE = 0) is on: no shake, pulse, pop, slide, press scale, squiggle draw, sticker settle or count-up; the squiggle and sticker appear in their final state. Colour changes and the timer bar still update. Timing of the game (1500 ms reveal) is unchanged.
